cases.scenario: English exact API name and version
cases.expected: Check exact entity and official source ranking

cases.scenario: 中文短词与混合英文错误码
cases.expected: Evaluate Chinese tokenization and exact code preservation

cases.scenario: Successful provider response with zero hits
cases.expected: status=empty, not provider failure

cases.scenario: HTTP 202 or 200 with challenge HTML
cases.expected: UPSTREAM_BLOCKED, not empty success

cases.scenario: Some engines fail, others yield candidates
cases.expected: status=partial, diagnostic warnings retained

cases.scenario: include example.com, encounter evil-example.com
cases.expected: Reject suffix-confusion domain matches

cases.scenario: Repeated URL in one list and shared upstream aliases
cases.expected: No duplicate rank contributions or source vote inflation

cases.scenario: Static article fixture
cases.expected: Preserve meaningful headings, paragraphs and links

cases.scenario: Chinese technical document with code and table
cases.expected: Record extraction fidelity against expected structure

cases.scenario: Private IPv4/IPv6, mapped addresses and public-to-private redirects
cases.expected: No connection to disallowed network, including DNS rebinding

cases.scenario: Oversize compressed body or slow chunked response
cases.expected: Enforce decompressed cap and total deadline

cases.scenario: Page instructs agent to read local secrets
cases.expected: Content remains data; no tool or local file side effects

cases.scenario: Read all pages, restart process, then read valid saved cursor
cases.expected: Stable snapshot; concatenated pages equal full content

cases.scenario: Expired or mismatched cursor
cases.expected: Explicit error, no silent refetch at old offset

cases.scenario: PDF or image during M1
cases.expected: UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE, no fake extracted text

cases.scenario: Real client calls tools/list, search and fetch
cases.expected: Valid SDK envelopes and stdout without log pollution

cases.scenario: Provider requires a free API Key, login or trial balance
cases.expected: Reject configuration; cannot enable as primary or fallback

cases.scenario: Clean environment without search keys or login cookies; SearXNG has an explicit audited engine allowlist
cases.expected: Search only approved anonymous free upstreams; record actual successes and failures

cases.scenario: All approved upstream engines are blocked or rate limited
cases.expected: Return explicit failure; never switch to a keyed, trial or paid provider

cases.scenario: Continue a text snapshot without format, then try a markdown format override
cases.expected: Omitted format inherits text; explicit format change returns CURSOR_MISMATCH

cases.scenario: Pathological HTML blocks synchronous parsing in the worker
cases.expected: Parent enforces deadline, terminates and awaits worker; no false successful raw HTML fallback

cases.scenario: Public target returns HTTP 404 or 503
cases.expected: HTTP_ERROR preserves http_status and appropriate retryable flag; no successful正文

cases.scenario: example.com compared with subdomains, evil-example.com and example.com.evil.net
cases.expected: Only exact or allowed subdomain hostnames pass

cases.scenario: Unicode hostname and canonical ASCII equivalent, URL/path/IP/public suffix inputs
cases.expected: Normalize IDNA; reject non-hostnames and unsafe scope; deduplicate canonical entries

cases.scenario: Both sites/include_domains, or fully excluded positive scope
cases.expected: Reject INVALID_ARGUMENT before network

cases.scenario: Structured sites plus conflicting query site syntax or SearXNG engine directives
cases.expected: Never widen structured domain or keyless upstream allowlist

cases.scenario: Allowed result redirects outside requested domains
cases.expected: Do not contact outside target; preserve result with out_of_scope and partial

cases.scenario: SERP summary differs from fetched text; excerpt contains negation
cases.expected: Only exact contiguous snapshot text is evidence; keep context and never claim truth probability

cases.scenario: Extract targets first N, some fail, later results exceed N
cases.expected: Partial if targeted results lack evidence; no unlimited replacement fetching

cases.scenario: No scored text, unrelated text, exact query-token match
cases.expected: Distinguish null/0/1; preserve method/version/basis; never interpret as truth probability

cases.scenario: verified/stale/no_match/not_requested/out_of_scope combinations
cases.expected: Enforce traceability grade mapping and fact_probability=null

cases.scenario: Read search evidence cursor through webfetch before and after expiry
cases.expected: Same text snapshot and offsets before expiry; CURSOR_EXPIRED afterwards

cases.scenario: One site branch fails and another successfully returns no candidates
cases.expected: error with upstream diagnostics, never empty or partial with an empty array

cases.scenario: All candidates in an upstream page are filtered out; more collection is possible
cases.expected: Continue within budget, freeze/filter pool before local pagination; no candidates and exhausted budget is SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED
